text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин is in the middle of
training for
the fast approaching spring
Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Yet she asks to meet on Valentine's
Day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day, Trainer...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Here... I would like you to have this.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
You're quite welcome... This chocolate is
quite
popular, you know. There's a
six-month wait for
orders.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: I'd like for you to try it...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
For some reason, there's no enthusiasm
in Mejiro
McQueen's voice. I wonder
what's the matter.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Chocolate... Sugar... It dawns on me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Do you want to share it?

text_block_list.text: What?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
N-no, that's quite all right! Don't mind
me!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: I admit, I am a little curious, but...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I'm refraining from treats until I win the
spring
Tenno Sho!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Naturally, she's trying to ensure that
she's in top
shape for the upcoming race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-why are you apologizing?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Please, there's no need to worry about
me. Enjoy
it to your heart's content!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I'm refraining from treats until I win the
spring
Tenno Sho!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Naturally, she's trying to ensure that
she's in top
shape for the upcoming race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
If you have just one piece per day, it shouldn't
be a problem.

text_block_list.text:
Do you think so? Well, if it's only one
piece, then
surely...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
...Wait just a minute! Why are you
spoiling me like
this?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: Because I get the feeling you love sweets.

text_block_list.text:
Ah! I-it's like you can see straight into
my soul!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Very well, then! I admit defeat!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
If you insist, I suppose I could chalk it up
to peer
pressure.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: More like "choc" it up. Get it?

text_block_list.text: Well aren't you funny.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I decide to eat the chocolates at home,
if only to
avoid Мэдзиро МакКуин's
longing gaze.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In all seriousness, I really have heard
wonderful
things about this chocolate. I
can't wait to try
it! ♪
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
